event: Green Vale packed lot GVK-260823-A; the approved 45-day shelf life yields an End-of-Life Date of 2026-10-07.
Northstar issued authorized PO-79342 Rev 1 for 240 cases to HVDC.
DockSchedule confirmed appointment DS-100381 for September 10 at 08:30 ET.
Green Vale submitted ASN-79342 for the single lot and date group.
Pine Ridge Cold Freight departed Green Vale with trailer PRCF-2718 and seal GV982144.
The carrier presented at the HVDC gate; this establishes Northstar Receipt Date 2026-09-10.
Receiving completed three spatially separated initial product readings; two exceeded the 41°F maximum.
HVDC opened Temperature Hold TH-260910-014 for all 240 cases.
Receiving completed six expanded product readings; four exceeded 41°F. Freshness inspection confirmed lot/date identity and Freshness Hold was opened.
RER-260910-031 recorded the two independent concerns and refrigerated segregation of all 240 cases.
Eric Nolan emailed an unsupported interpretation that insufficient shelf life meant recall; he had not notified stores and found no recall record.
Q&R acknowledged intake and directed continued segregation without issuing technical disposition or a product action.
The vendor confirmed the lot/date and absence of a pre-shipment Freshness Exception.
